jobs.title: Cloud FinOps Engineer
jobs.description: Daylight is a security services company delivering Managed Agentic Security Services (MASS), including MDR, threat hunting, security data lake, and more, through a fundamentally different architecture than traditional security services providers. Daylight's architecture combines an agentic platform that runs the full cycle from detection to response with security experts from IR and threat hunting backgrounds. The platform collects identity and business context across systems to investigate alerts and continuously learns your environment. Security experts validate decisions, feed insights into the platform, optimize detections, and take over in case of an incident. The result: security teams move from firefighting to strategic work. We’re looking for a Cloud FinOps Engineer to own and drive cloud cost optimization across Daylight’s infrastructure. You’ll work hands-on across AWS, Kubernetes, and our data and observability stack to improve efficiency, optimize cloud spend, and build the tooling and processes that help us scale sustainably. What You’ll Do Own cloud cost as a metric: define, instrument, and report unit economics such as cost per tenant, per GB ingested, and per environment, and drive them down quarter over quarter Build cost visibility through tagging and allocation standards, showback across teams and customers, budgets, anomaly detection, and dashboards people actually open Find and land savings across compute right-sizing, Karpenter and Spot strategy, commitment coverage, storage lifecycle policies, networking and data transfer, and the long tail of idle resources Optimize the cost of our data and observability layers, including streaming ingestion, the data lake and warehouse, and the observability pipeline Shift cost left by putting estimates into pull requests and IaC review, so engineers see the price of a change before it ships rather than in next month's bill Build and maintain infrastructure as code, our GitOps delivery pipeline, and Kubernetes platform work alongside the rest of the team, and participate in on-call Partner with Engineering, Finance, and leadership on forecasting, vendor and contract renewals, and capacity planning What we're looking for 4+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, with hands-on responsibility for production workloads on AWS. Strong Kubernetes experience, ideally with EKS, including autoscaling and workload right-sizing. Strong Infrastructure-as-Code practices using Terraform, with experience working in GitOps-style environments. Scripting or development experience in Go, Python, or a similar language, with the ability to automate analysis and build internal tooling. Proven ownership of cloud cost optimization initiatives, with measurable results. Strong understanding of AWS billing and cost management, including Cost Explorer, CUR, allocation tags, and commitment models. Comfortable working in an AI-native environment, using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow. Able to work independently in a small, fast-moving team and take a problem from initial identification through implementation. Why this role You’ll be the first person at Daylight to own FinOps, so you’ll be building the practice rather than inheriting one. Our infrastructure is modern and fully codified — Terraform, ArgoCD, EKS, and Karpenter — giving you the opportunity to focus on meaningful optimization from day one. At our stage of growth, the decisions you make now will directly shape our infrastructure efficiency and cost structure as we scale.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: Daylight is a security services company delivering Managed Agentic Security Services (MASS), including MDR, threat hunting, security data lake, and more, through a fundamentally different architecture than traditional security services providers. Daylight's architecture combines an agentic platform that runs the full cycle from detection to response with security experts from IR and threat hunting backgrounds. The platform collects identity and business context across systems to investigate alerts and continuously learns your environment. Security experts validate decisions, feed insights into the platform, optimize detections, and take over in case of an incident. The result: security teams move from firefighting to strategic work. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to join our globally distributed, high-impact security engineering team. You will design and implement detection logic, investigate alerts, and automate response mechanisms. As an early hire, you'll work closely with our platform and AI teams to shape how autonomous threat detection and response is built and delivered at scale. Responsibilities: Lead Investigations: Triage, analyze, and respond to alerts across cloud, endpoint, and network environments with automation-first principles. Build Detections: Write detection logic and behavioral rules as code that is clear, testable, and scalable. Automate Response Workflows: Develop Go-based automation for enrichment, containment, and remediation playbooks. Define Detection-as-Code Practices: Implement a detection and response framework with strong engineering fundamentals (testing, CI/CD, version control). Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with platform and AI teams to integrate detection logic into the broader Daylight stack. Support DFIR: Participate in incident investigations and post-incident reviews; DFIR skills (memory, disk, or cloud forensics) are a strong plus. Requirements: Security Operations Experience: 3+ years in detection engineering, incident response, or blue team roles. Automation Mindset: You automate what others manually repeat. Experience building or integrating automated response systems is key. Cloud-Native Awareness: Familiarity with detecting and responding to threats in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). DFIR Skills: Practical experience in digital forensics and incident response — logs, memory, containers, cloud. Threat-Informed Thinking: Comfort with attacker tactics and techniques (MITRE ATT&CK, behavioral detection, threat modeling).
